value.message: Town of Oakville has Preschool A Learn to Swim, ages 3-5 no parent needed, Saturdays 9:00-9:30am, Sept 12 to Nov 28 - their site says. Fees are set by Council and published in the Recreation Guide. Fall registration opens Tues Aug 11 at 7am for residents. I'll keep watching for the fee and text you.
